uutiset.t: ETF, CEF, Swap, Perp: Investors Get Slice of Anthropic Before IPO
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC’s much-anticipated Nasdaq debut isn’t expected until later this week, but retail traders are already finding ways to get a piece of the AI giant.

uutiset.t: Nasdaq 100 Futures Rise as Investors Prepare for Nvidia Results
uutiset.s: Technology stocks climbed before the bell on Tuesday as investors prepared for an all-important earnings release from Nvidia Corp. and as a selloff in the artificial intelligence trade eased.

uutiset.t: Amazon, Google to Have About 28% of Anthropic Stock After IPO
uutiset.s: Two of Anthropic PBC’s biggest customers will have about 28% of its stock in aggregate after it goes public, adding to the close links between the companies powering the artificial intelligence boom.

uutiset.t: Hungary Holds Key Interest Rate as Global Risks Support Caution
uutiset.s: Hungary left its key interest rate steady for a third month as central bankers assess an uptick in inflation against the backdrop of higher borrowing costs across the world.

uutiset.t: Private Equity Finds a Year-End Window to Take Cash Out of Firms
uutiset.s: Private equity’s buyout machine may be idling as the year draws to a close, but sponsors are still finding ways to mint cash from the companies they own.

uutiset.t: Copper’s Unravelling AI Trade Collides With a Historic Squeeze
uutiset.s: A growing divide between bearish investors and tight physical markets is creating a risky setup for metals.

uutiset.t: Chile Central Bank Says New Rules Eased Fallout From Swap Losses
uutiset.s: Chile’s central bank said ample liquidity and new risk-based rules limiting the use of derivatives helped contain the fallout from losses on massive swap positions held by the country’s pension funds.

uutiset.t: Argentina’s Energy Boom to Extend Surge of Bond Sales Into 2027
uutiset.s: A wave of dollar bond sales by Argentine companies and provinces is set to extend into the first half of next year, driven by the country’s booming energy industry, according to Banco Santander, the top underwriter for such deals.

uutiset.t: Swiss Pharma Employee Convicted Over $300,000 in Insider Trades
uutiset.s: An employee of Swiss healthcare supplier SKAN Group AG was found guilty of insider trading after his appeal of a penalty order handed down by Swiss prosecutors was rejected.

uutiset.t: US Funding for Trump-Linked Bosnian Gas Pipeline Is in Jeopardy
uutiset.s: US federal funding of $2.3 billion in energy and airport infrastructure projects in Bosnia-Herzegovina are in jeopardy as government development banks in Washington distanced themselves from the plan.

uutiset.t: Disney Profit Beats With Marvel Films Powering Streaming
uutiset.s: Walt Disney Co. reported sales and earnings that exceeded analysts’ expectations, with a particularly strong result in its streaming TV unit.

uutiset.t: Nvidia’s Earnings Come at a Time of Mounting Tech Turmoil
uutiset.s: Stock has plunged 35% from October peak, dragging Nasdaq lower.

uutiset.t: Home Depot Names McPhail CEO With Decker Back as Chairman
uutiset.s: Home Depot Inc. said Richard McPhail will take over as chief executive officer from Ted Decker, who is returning from medical leave to serve as chairman.
